clean.root_cause: The agent did not open any cabinets or drawers to find a plate, which was not visible on any surfaces.
clean.evidence: After arriving at cabinet 1, the agent saw nothing on top and did not open it; later returned to countertop 1 without ever opening any container.
clean.corrective_rule: When the target object is not visible on surfaces, systematically open all cabinets and drawers.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Missing strategy for searching inside closed containers when objects are not in plain sight.
clean.patch_location: Under 'Exploration and Search', add a new subsection '### Systematic Container Search'.

cool.root_cause: The agent only opened one cabinet (empty) and did not search other containers or locate the microwave receptacle.
cool.evidence: After opening cabinet 1 and finding nothing, the agent returned to countertop 1 without exploring other cabinets or drawers.
cool.corrective_rule: Search all containers (cabinets, drawers) and also navigate to the target receptacle before starting the cooling process.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of comprehensive search covering all potential object locations and the target receptacle.
cool.patch_location: Under 'Exploration and Search', add a new subsection '### Systematic Container Search'.

cool.root_cause: The agent never opened any cabinets or drawers, only searched surfaces, and never found a mug or went to the coffeemachine.
cool.evidence: Only opened the fridge (found no mug) and then wandered among countertops without opening any closed containers.
cool.corrective_rule: Always open all cabinets and drawers when the target object is not on surfaces, and verify the receptacle location early.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Missing the step to open containers for object search and receptacle identification.

cool.root_cause: The agent did not open any cabinets or drawers to find a potato, only checked surfaces and the fridge.

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent opened only two drawers and one cabinet, all empty, then returned to the desk without searching remaining containers like cabinet 2.
pick_and_place.evidence: After opening drawer 2 (empty) and cabinet 1 (empty), the agent went to desk 1 again and then attempted cabinet 2 but the observation indicates it did not actually go there.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: Continue searching all containers until the target object is found; do not return to a previous location without checking all options.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Lack of exhaustive search routine; agent stops too early after a few empty containers.
pick_and_place.patch_location: Under 'Exploration and Search', add a new subsection '### Exhaustive Container Search'.

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent only looked at shelves and never opened any drawer or cabinet to find a pen.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent picked up an irrelevant object (cloth) and then entered a loop of repeated 'look' actions without progressing toward the task.

pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Avoid picking up objects not required by the task; if stuck in a loop, force a different action (e.g., go to a new location or open a container).
